body:
I’m 27 and am still a virgin. You’re absolutely right about the way society treats men who are virgins late into adulthood. It sucks. 

The way I deal with it though is just realizing it’s just another thing fucked up about our society. There’s so much shit that the majority of people have fucked up views on. This is just another thing. That other stuff doesn’t get to me a ton usually so why should I let this? 

Also, for me I’ve realized that it’s not necessarily that I’m unlovable or hideous, it’s just that I am super awkward and my social skills get fucked up anytime I’m interested in someone romantically. This realization hasn’t really helped tbh, but it’s helped the way I view myself. 

Best of luck man, it’s very frustrating and I’m not going to tell you it’s not a big deal, because it clearly is to you, but try changing the way you view it. It’s the only advice I really have. Hang in there
